eyebrow: From user count to a memory budget
title: Which GPU can hold this workload?
intro: Choose a model and workload. If you have not selected a GPU, the tool suggests candidates to test. A memory fit is an estimate; speed and service quality still need testing.
replicas: A complete model on each GPU; distribute requests
activeNote: Connected users and requests waiting in a queue are excluded.
tokenNote: Question, documents, history and generated output; package limit:
settings: Memory assumptions and actual free space
example: Illustrative model: 8 billion parameters, raw BF16 weights, 32 layers, 8 KV heads and a head dimension of 128.
fileBasis: Weight size comes from the GGUF files recorded in the LLM table; actual memory after loading may differ.
reserve: Engine and buffer reserve per GPU (GiB)
free: Free memory before loading the model, per GPU (GiB)
assumptions: The default 2 GiB reserve is the table’s planning assumption, not a measurement or an overhead ceiling. Quantized weights do not imply a low-precision KV cache: check engine support and cache accuracy separately. This full-attention estimate assumes no savings from prefix caching, sliding-window attention, MLA or hybrid architectures.
barAria: Memory budget per GPU, in GiB
replicaNote: With balanced distribution, the busiest GPU is assumed to handle {active} requests. Each GPU loads the complete weights; queues and uneven distribution can change this estimate.
shardNote: Weights and KV are assumed to split evenly. Actual layer placement, duplicated KV heads and communication buffers may need more memory on one GPU; total memory does not certify multi-GPU execution.
nominalNote: For initial screening, the table’s nominal memory class is treated as a GiB budget. Before deployment, enter the device’s actual free memory.
freeNote: Enter free device memory before loading this model. Account separately for overhead and other components that have not yet been loaded.
ceilingNote: The theoretical limit above does not establish capacity at an acceptable latency.
empty: No candidate with memory headroom was found for these settings. Change the GPU count, context length or active requests; the GPU table has more options.
recommendationNote: Candidates come from the site’s current GPU list, ordered by the fewest devices and then memory capacity. Price, speed and package compatibility with each engine still need checking. When more devices are needed, the suggested count appears beside the GPU name.
noCandidates: No suitable candidate in this group; change the deployment group or memory workload.
excluded: Suggestions exclude announced products, unofficial boards, unified system memory and pooled multi-chip capacity. For AMD and Intel, check package, kernel and engine support on the exact model and operating system.
workload: Explore user load and token demand
inFlight: User requests in flight; Little’s law
littleNote: In steady state, Little’s law includes the queue and all workflow stages. It does not automatically set the running-inference slider. Input and output are counted separately; the assumed response time is not a prediction by this tool.
invalidDemand: Enter valid numbers to calculate demand.
prefill: Measured prefill capacity on this configuration (tokens/second)
decode: Measured decode capacity on this configuration (tokens/second)
pressureNote: These ratios are only an initial screen. Stage interference, P95, bursts and goodput need testing under a mixed workload. Enter measured capacity for the entire configuration; the tool does not multiply speed by GPU count. Changing the model, deployment or request length clears the measurements so you can enter results for the new settings.
articleLink: What do 100 concurrent users mean for an AI assistant?
guideIntro: Use the tool below to compare concurrency and context length against your model and GPU count. The accompanying article explains the calculations and how to design a service capacity test.

status.conditional: Candidate for model splitting and testing
status.unsupported: Multi-GPU splitting is unverified for this package
status.invalid: Complete the inputs within the allowed ranges
